name: bleep-checkout
description: Monorepo do Bleep Checkout: apps/api (NestJS) e apps/web (Angular), gerenciados por npm workspaces com um único package-lock.json na raiz.

scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web -- --watch=false
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
